# Jose Ramon Martinez Saavedra

> Builds verifiable entropy infrastructure for cybersecurity and accelerated computing. VP of Innovation at Quside Technologies.

## Summary

Leads R&D across the entropy stack: photonic entropy sources and chips, FPGA and silicon implementations, drivers and SDKs (e.g. quside-curand for NVIDIA CUDA), NIST SP 800-90B-compliant sources, and integration with post-quantum cryptography. Co-inventor across 8 patent families (US, EP, CN, JP); 30+ families under management. PI of EUR 5.6M+ in competitive R&D funding (Horizon Europe/EIC, CDTI). PhD in Photonics (UPC/ICFO). MBA (Valar Institute).
